top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) recognizes a mature, independently confirmed discovery chain from incretin physiology and proglucagon/receptor biology to the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, with replicated randomized evidence on glycaemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The allocation maps onto three separable steps and the citation, framed around the hormone and its active form, keeps Knudsen's exclusion coherent. The contested Mojsov priority versus Habener is the main residual risk, but it is an unverified doubt and does not outweigh the case, so an award is clearly preferable to no award.
